Changelog
Full release history
Every beta build in one place. Use this page for the complete history while the home page stays focused on the product itself.
3.0.8
Release
Build 308
2026-10-21
Fixed
Treemap and Sunburst show the same legend. Disk Map adds up each category across the whole folder, including items too small to draw. Before, each view counted what it drew, so the two legends disagreed
Scans skip virtual volumes such as DeviceFS in ~/Library/Developer/CoreDevice. DeviceFS takes no space on your Mac. Before, scans of your home folder and startup disk counted its contents as part of ~/Library/Developer
Folder scans stay on the folder's own volume. Disks and disk images mounted inside the folder appear as empty folders. Scans of the startup disk and of /Volumes keep counting connected disks
The Disk Map tooltip hides the item count for folders the map hasn't loaded. Before, a large folder deep in the tree could show “Items 0”
3.0.7
Release
Build 307
2026-10-20
Added
A heads-up before the first scan when less than 2 GB is free
Improved
Clear guidance when your disk is full. If a scan can't save its results because the disk is out of space, StorageRadar now says so and offers Dev Cleanup, App Uninstaller and Open Trash — they free up space without a scan. Before, you saw a generic “Scan failed” error, and Retry failed again
Fixed
Closing the App Store payment sheet no longer looks like an error (App Store version). Before, cancelling a purchase could show “Purchase failed”
3.0.6
Release
Build 306
2026-10-15
Fixed
Scans keep going while macOS asks for access. If macOS shows an access dialog during a Home Folder scan, StorageRadar finishes the scan and lists the folders that didn't open in time. Answer the dialog, then rescan. Before, the scan stayed at 0 files until you answered
Categories appear right after a scan. Before, the bar in Disk Overview showed only Other & not scanned until you restarted the app
3.0.5
Release
Build 305
2026-10-12
Fixed
Docker inside Colima is counted once. When Docker runs in the Colima VM, its images and build cache live on the VM disk that Colima Runtime Data already counts. The Developer caches total added them a second time. The Docker card now shows an Inside Colima VM label
3.0.4
Release
Build 304
2026-10-12
Fixed
Undo in Developer caches. After a cleanup, the Undo button stays on screen for 10 seconds and returns the items from the Trash. Before, this screen moved items to the Trash without it
3.0.3
Release
Build 303
2026-10-12
Fixed
Review & Apply scrolls again. With dozens of simulators, Xcode archives or other items, the window cut off the Run Dry Run and Apply Cleanup buttons
3.0.2
Release
Build 302
2026-10-11
Added
A new “Rate StorageRadar…” item in the app menu (App Store version)
Improved
If StorageRadar can't open ~/Library/Developer yet, it asks for access once and scans the folder right away
Fixed
The developer scan no longer ends in an error on a Mac without Xcode data. StorageRadar says there is no Xcode data on this Mac and opens Dev Cleanup, which still covers caches from Homebrew, npm, Docker and other developer tools
3.0.0
Release
Build 300
2026-09-22
Added
Disk Overview is the new home screen: free space, what is using it, and what you can reclaim, with dedicated states for a first launch, a scan in progress, and a disk with nothing to clean. The sidebar now has five sections
Improved
Redesigned interface: a new color, type, and spacing system, a brand accent in place of the system blue, and one category palette for light and dark mode
Disk Map colors items by category and adds breadcrumbs, a legend, and an inspector panel. After a cleanup it refreshes without asking for another scan
Duplicate Review rebuilt: stage-by-stage scan progress, file counts per group, a 10-second undo window, and empty states that explain why the list is empty
App Uninstaller and Dev Cleanup reworked: a removal plan fits on one line, a missing permission shows up as a task instead of an error, and each cleanup profile states its consequence before you run it
Scanning shows a real percentage with a Stop button and stops as soon as you press it. Post-processing is faster
Complete translations for all 10 languages, with real plural forms in place of “file(s)”
Fixed
Size numbers reconciled across the app: folder totals, category sums, and header counts now agree with the lists beneath them
2.2.4
Release
Build 224
2026-07-11
Improved
App Uninstaller: Preview Removal now works even while the app you want to remove is still running — previewing is a safe dry run and never deletes anything
If an app truly cannot be closed automatically, StorageRadar now tells you instead of retrying silently
Clearer error reporting for scanning, purchases, and restoring purchases
Fixed
Move to Trash no longer asks you to quit the app by hand, and no longer stalls on apps that keep a background helper running. StorageRadar closes them for you and says so up front
2.2.2
Release
Build 222
2026-07-09
Improved
Improved diagnostics for scanning and in-app purchases, helping us detect and fix rare issues faster
Minor internal refinements for better long-term reliability
2.2.1
Release
Build 221
2026-07-06
Improved
Background scans keep full speed when the app is minimized
Improved diagnostics to pinpoint where a slow scan gets stuck
Fixed
More reliable scanning on large disks — scans no longer stall or slow to a crawl, even with lots of cloud files
The scanner now skips unreachable iCloud files and network drives instead of getting stuck, so every scan finishes
2.2.0
Release
Build 220
2026-07-03
Improved
StorageRadar 2.2.0 updates the App Store listing for disk space, Xcode, Docker, and cleanup searches. Cleanup behavior stays the same
2.1.9
Release
Build 211
2026-06-30
Improved
Clearer status — if preparation ever fails, you see a clear message instead of an endless spinner
Fixed
Disk Map fix — the disk map now builds reliably after a scan instead of getting stuck on "preparing."
Stability improvements and minor fixes throughout
2.1.0
Release
Build 210
2026-06-15
Added
A clear finish — removing an app ends on a summary that counts up the space you reclaimed, next to the app name and where it lived
Honest about the Trash — when an app moves to the Trash, you're told the space returns once you empty it, with Empty Trash (or Open Trash) right there
Leftovers in one step — if related caches or settings remain, the summary shows how much is left and takes you straight to review them
Improved
Clearer removal confirmation — before an app leaves your Mac you see exactly what happens: its icon, how many items and how much space, and a plain "will be moved to Trash" instead of a wall of text
Nothing hidden — items that may hold your data are flagged in amber; anything that can't be removed (no access or system-protected) is listed separately under "Won't be removed"
Fixed
Undo you can trust — the Undo button only ever reverses the removal you just made
Buttons that fit — permission guidance now wraps cleanly on smaller screens, with nothing cut off
Stability improvements and minor fixes throughout
2.0.4
Release
Build 204
2026-06-09
Added
Buy and upgrade right inside the app: get Core or Developer straight from the Unlock screen, with checkout opening securely in your browser and your license key arriving by email within minutes
One-tap upgrade from Core to Developer that unlocks Dev Cleanup for Xcode, Docker, and caches plus Reports compare and export, without re-buying
Improved
Clearer Unlock screen that puts buying front and center, with "Already have a license key?" and App Store recovery tucked into tidy collapsible sections
Less guesswork at checkout: a hint shows which address your key email comes from, and a Contact support button appears if a key reaches its device limit
Full, natural localization across all 10 languages — English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, and Simplified Chinese — with no more screens falling back to English
One-time purchases, no subscription ever, and nothing removed automatically: every cleanup still asks for confirmation and Move to Trash can be undone
2.0.1
Release
Build 201
2026-05-30
Added
New first run that starts you on a safe Home Folder scan instead of a generic welcome, with confirmation always required before anything is removed
Accessible risk levels: safe, caution, and danger now read by icon as well as color, with full Increase Contrast support
Improved
A refreshed, more native look across every screen, with flatter surfaces, lighter shadows, and consistent spacing for a calmer, clearer app
Calmer Home with a disk-space overview at a glance and quieter, easier-to-scan cards
Duplicate Review now matches the app's light theme, with larger text, less on-screen clutter, and scan progress that stays visible while scanning
Clearer Unlock screen with a recommended plan, benefit-focused wording, and a reclaimable-space estimate
1.9.9
Release
Build 99
2026-05-22
Added
Duplicate Review now finds exact duplicate folders, not just files, confirmed by a full content fingerprint so only genuinely identical folders are grouped for review
Improved
Faster exact-folder matching that reuses an in-memory index and partial content hashes to skip unnecessary full-file reads on large Home folders
Safer broad scans, with exact-folder matching skipping Library, Trash, caches, and app containers, the same protected areas already excluded for files
Cloud-aware by default: cloud-only files and provider placeholders are skipped before any read in local-only mode, so nothing is downloaded just to scan it
Hardlink-aware savings estimates so the reclaimable space shown reflects what you would actually get back
Steadier progress during long folder scans instead of going quiet until the end
1.9.5
Release
Build 95
2026-05-18
Added
Duplicate Review, a new review-first workflow for finding exact duplicate files, comparing potential savings, previewing selections, and moving verified copies to Trash only after review
Improved
Duplicate Review handles large scans with clearer group ordering, faster scrolling, and a more focused Preview flow before moving anything to Trash
Disk Map details are easier to understand, with clearer file and folder labels, readable action buttons, and improved wording across supported languages
Guided onboarding helps you find the right next step in Home and Disk Analysis without getting in the way
Active scans and long-running work are easier to follow with a top activity strip and Stop controls where supported
Stability, performance, and privacy-safe diagnostics have been improved across cleanup, uninstall, purchases, and reports

Localization coverage for new App Uninstaller, Dev Cleanup, and Permissions strings

Docker cleanup controls for stopped containers and volumes
German localization for new features

Access troubleshooting in App Uninstaller with clearer instructions when macOS requires App Management or admin approval
Finder fallback for apps in /Applications, using the system recycle mechanism to work around sandbox restrictions

Improved handling when folder access is limited or blocked

Refined window layout and spacing throughout the app
Fixed
Paywall screens now properly adapt to light and dark system themes

2026-03-25

Guided Review and Apply flows for Xcode Archives, CoreSimulator data, iOS Device Support, and Android Emulator AVD artifacts
New Dev Cleanup profiles for Rust Cargo Registry Cache, Rust Cargo Git Cache, CocoaPods artifacts, and Carthage artifacts

Xcode Archives cleanup with quicker actions, clearer grouping by date, and better selection previews
Richer explanations for cleanup targets so it is easier to understand what each profile contains, why it was flagged, and what may happen after removal

macOS permission handling for app removal and leftover cleanup, with clearer guidance when extra access is required

Support for the full set of app languages
